observations: Photo 0: a cast aluminium engine module with a helical drive gear and sprocket at one end, several 12-point bolts, and long through-bolts fitted, lying on an oily workshop floor; another engine part is in the background.
Photo 1: the same module held in a hand, showing two machined shaft ends with bearings and the long mounting bolts; casting looks clean and bright.
Photo 2: the underside of the module with an attached oil pump or pickup housing; a cast mark reads '5-B'; a green paint mark on the pump body; some light grime and oil.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI UCHENNA' on every photo.
No brand logo, part number or casting code identifying the maker or engine is readable in any photo.
No visible cracks, broken lugs or missing gear teeth in what is shown; the gear faces and shaft bearings are not shown close up.
Nothing shows the part off a specific car or engine.

identity.kind: engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly
read_from: photo 0 and photo 1 shape only: balance shaft module with oil pump, no readable part number

claims.claim: Engine oil pump balance shaft assembly
claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show a balance shaft module with drive gear, shafts and an integrated oil pump housing.

claims.claim: For Toyota cars like Camry (2018 to present) and RAV4
claims.evidence: No Toyota mark or part number is readable; only a '5-B' cast mark in photo 2. Fitment cannot be read off the part.
No close-up of gear teeth, shaft bearings or pump rotors, and no rotation clip; priced as worn.

risks.risk: The assembly is not for the Toyota engines claimed, or for a different variant; fitment sets the price.
risks.proof: Sharp close-up of the cast or stamped part number on the housing, with a handwritten code and date in shot.
risks.if_unproven: not priced as a Toyota part; held until the part number is readable

risks.risk: Worn or chipped gear teeth, worn shaft bearings or scored pump rotors.
risks.proof: Close-up of the drive gear teeth and both shaft bearing surfaces, plus a clip turning the gear by hand to show the shafts spin smoothly.

risks.risk: Cracked housing or stripped bolt threads not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Photos of all six faces of the housing in good light.

risks.risk: Missing pieces such as pickup screen, relief valve or bolts.
risks.proof: One photo of everything included laid out on a clean surface.

proof_requests: Readable close-up of the part number cast or stamped on the housing, with a handwritten code and today's date in the frame.
Close-up of the drive gear teeth and shaft bearings, and a clip turning the gear by hand.
Photos of all faces of the housing to check for cracks.
Photo of all included parts laid out.
response.reason: The photos show an engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly, but no part number or maker mark is readable, so the claimed Toyota Camry and RAV4 fitment that sets its value is unproven and not even a worst case price is possible yet. A readable part number would allow pricing as worn until the gear and bearings are shown.
